units.source_text: 我已饱尝人世无常之苦，却至今未能出家，终于落在你后，实甚遗憾！

en.t: I have already tasted to the full the suffering of this impermanent world, yet even now I have been unable to leave it and take the tonsure; to have fallen behind you at last is truly a matter of deep regret!

units.source_text: 你虽已舍弃世事，但你总得在佛前回向，务请首先提我姓名，感激不尽。”

en.t: Though you have already renounced worldly affairs, when you dedicate your prayers before the Buddha, please be sure to mention my name first; I would be endlessly grateful.”
There were many other words besides these.

units.source_text: 胧月夜早已发心出家，只因有源氏牵累，故迁延至今方始实行。

en.t: Oborozukiyo had long since resolved to become a nun, but because of her ties to Genji she had delayed until now, when she finally put her resolve into action.

units.source_text: 此情她对外人未便明言，但心中不胜感慨。

en.t: She could not openly tell outsiders of these feelings, but in her heart she was overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 左思右想，觉得自己与源氏虽然自昔结下痛苦因缘，但恩情毕竟不浅。

en.t: Thinking it over from every side, she felt that although she and Genji had been bound together since long ago by a painful karma, the kindness between them had after all been far from shallow.

units.source_text: 自今以后，不能再通音信，此次作复，已是最后一次。

en.t: From now on they could no longer exchange letters, and this reply would already be the last.

units.source_text: 想到这里，不胜感伤，便用心作复，笔墨非常讲究。

en.t: When she thought of this, she could not contain her sorrow, and so she wrote her reply with great care, making the brushwork and ink especially refined.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“人世无常之苦，只有我一人知道。

en.t: In the letter she wrote: “The suffering of this impermanent human world is known to me alone.

units.source_text: 来信说你落在我后，诚然诚然：

en.t: Your letter says that you have fallen behind me; indeed, indeed, that is so:
